visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a person using a yellow hand torch to caramelize sugar on two banana halves in a silver pan. The setting is outdoors on a black textured table with grass in the background. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a man wearing a khaki bucket hat and a brown t-shirt. He is eating a piece of the banana, looking directly at the camera with a satisfied expression. (3) The video transitions to a preparation sequence. Hands are seen cutting a whole banana lengthwise on a black cutting board using a red-handled knife. (4) A silver square frying pan is placed on a green portable gas stove. A small amount of oil is drizzled into the pan. (5) The banana halves are placed into the pan and fried. The camera zooms in as the person uses black tongs to flip the bananas, showing a golden-brown seared texture. (6) The cooked bananas are transferred from the square pan onto a round silver plate. (7) White sugar is poured from a yellow and white paper bag onto the fried bananas. (8) The hand torch is used once more to melt the sugar directly on the plate, creating a bubbly brown caramel crust. (9) The man is shown again, cutting a piece of the finished dessert and eating it. He finishes by giving a thumbs-up gesture to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy upbeat pop BGM with female vocals in English plays continuously. A sharp mechanical click triggers a high-pressure torch hiss as it ignites. (2) Music remains steady. A wet, percussive chewing sound is heard from a male source, signifying the character tasting food. (3) Quick, rhythmic dull thuds of a knife hitting a plastic cutting board occur in sync with fast visual cuts. (4) A metallic click from a gas stove knob is followed by a soft gaseous hiss. A sudden bright sizzling sound begins as ingredients hit a hot pan. (5) High-frequency metallic clinks of tongs hitting a pan are interspersed with continuous sizzling. (6) A sharp rustling of a plasticized paper bag occurs as it is squeezed. (7) The torch re-ignites with a click and a loud, sustained airy hiss of a butane flame. (8) A scraping sound of metal against a metal plate is heard as a knife cuts through a crisp texture. (9) Final chewing sounds conclude the sequence with a soft satisfied exhale.
